prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production environment background for the existing warm painted 2D game, using the attached station overview as the layout reference and the attached station exterior and clothing shop as style/camera references. ONLY the GROUND FLOOR, no upper-floor overview, no sectional strip. Portrait 1024 x 1536 composition, fixed elevated three-quarter camera looking north, nearly parallel projection, gently angled like the reference's left ground-floor panel. Rich hand-painted gouache/watercolor, cream tiled floors, warm chestnut structural frames, deep railway-blue blank signboards, amber lights, leafy terracotta planters, soft sunset windows. A substantial long modern Suzhou-inspired railway station, not a tiny shop. Full-bleed usable art, no parchment margins. Keep vertical north-to-south arrangement faithful to the reference. Public entrance at bottom center (around x470,y1450) with an open broad threshold. Four glass-fronted ticket windows facing toward foreground in the bottom LEFT quadrant, approximately x80-350,y1110-1220, with blank deep-blue header. Broad unobstructed central aisle x400-680 runs from entrance upward to security. A flat wall mural on left wall around x50,y820; below it a blue public bench against the left wall around x100,y950. EXACTLY ONE ambient adult passenger seated naturally at the LEFT end of that bench with a small rolling suitcase beside their feet; right two seats empty for a live game character. No other humans, no panda. A freestanding blue map board next to right public wall around x670,y1030, turned toward center, blank cream display. Screening boundary runs all the way across public hall from left wall x50 to continuous platform divider x755, around y660. On its left, luggage conveyor and scanner, on its right ONE broad walk-through detector lane around x500-605, with a small identity desk beside the PUBLIC approach. Glass partitions JOIN all lane ends to walls, so no walk-around bypass. Detector lane opening must be empty and visibly wide; do NOT paint closed doors in the detector opening, a game-controlled barrier will be drawn there. Baggage belt has public input pointing toward foreground and screened output toward background. Staff position and desk empty for live actors. Beyond security, generous screened lobby y360-580, with stairs/escalator climbing AWAY from camera toward back wall in rear-left center x270-440,y180-360; accessible lift beside it x490-590. Blank blue sign above stair/lift. Long solid cream-and-wood divider runs vertically x760 from bottom to rear, strictly separates PUBLIC HALL at left from GROUND LEVEL train platform at right. Through/over this divider show the long narrow sunny above-ground platform, cream paving, steel canopy and a silver-and-blue intercity TRAIN continuing beyond right edge. At front-right platform is base of a different staircase descending FROM unseen upstairs onto platform, separated completely from public ticketing. This is background preview; NO doorway or shortcut through divider. Exterior trees/sky beyond platform, not underground. Keep foreground entrance unobstructed. No painted staff, no moving passengers, no player, no UI. Remove ALL writing, lettering, numbers, icons, arrows and diagram captions: blank blue signs and blank mural caption area only. High detail consistent with the exterior game plate. Ensure all objects have believable feet and leave broad circulation spaces.

Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent sprite atlas for a warm hand-painted gouache/watercolor 2D Suzhou railway station game. Three isolated adult characters, separate FULL BODIES, arranged side-by-side in three equal cells on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas. No floor, scenery, labels, lettering, UI, desk or chairs; genuinely transparent alpha between and around silhouettes. Match cozy painted storybook station art, fixed elevated three-quarter game camera, slightly simplified expressive faces, natural proportions. Left cell: friendly female Chinese ticket clerk, navy railway uniform jacket, cream blouse, small blue scarf, dark trousers, black shoes, neatly tied hair, standing facing slightly right toward viewer with hands resting at waist. Center cell: friendly male Chinese station security assistant, navy uniform suit and blue cap, small gold insignia, black shoes, standing facing slightly left toward viewer, one open palm welcoming gesture at waist. Right cell: adult female passenger, muted teal cardigan, cream trousers, dark flats, sitting relaxed on an INVISIBLE bench, viewed from front slightly left; hips bent, thighs horizontal, knees naturally bent and feet below; holding a small book in lap, backpack beside left foot, no chair painted. Important consistent standing height about 760px, bodies separated by wide transparent gutters. Seated person total height about 580px, feet aligned on same baseline y925. Soft painted shading integrated inside silhouettes, no external ground shadows. No detached props except her nearby backpack, no other figures.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this production game background with ONE essential correction. Preserve all public hall artwork and its exact positions, scale, perspective, color, lighting, dimensions and objects: ticket windows bottom-left, entrance bottom-center, left mural and bench and its single passenger, blue map sign, security desk/scanner/detector, continuous glass security boundary, stairs/escalators and lift at the back. Do not shift or resize any of that. REMOVE the entire train, platform, platform canopy, right-hand platform stairs, and platform benches currently seen on the RIGHT side beyond the long divider (roughly x720-1024). The public ticket hall must NOT offer ANY view of a train or platform. In their place extend the divider upward into a tall fully OPAQUE cream plaster and chestnut timber right-side wall, with warm amber wall lamps, following EXACTLY the existing divider's footprint and perspective. This is the inside face of a substantial enclosed station hall. The wall fills the space where the train and platform were and continues beyond the top/right image edges; NO cutaway into a room beyond it, NO train, NO railway tracks, NO platform, NO exterior canopy, NO right-hand staircase, NO opening through this side wall. Preserve the clear public walking floor to the left of the existing divider, and preserve the existing entrance door and map sign in the same place. This is a targeted replacement of scenery BEYOND the right divider; keep the remaining 75% of image pixel-position consistent for existing collision traces. Blank signs, no letters or icons. Warm hand-painted gouache illustration, 1024x1536 portrait.

Use case: precise-object-edit. CORRECT ARCHITECTURAL HEIGHT ONLY. This is floor 1 of a TWO-FLOOR railway station; the waiting hall's floor is directly above it. Current right wall is absurdly tall, like a three-storey atrium. Reduce BOTH SIDE WALLS to a believable SINGLE-STOREY height, about 2.5 standing adult heights, with a clear thick horizontal timber/cream CEILING SLAB EDGE at that modest height showing that a second floor is directly overhead. Use a dollhouse/cutaway treatment of the roof so the ground floor remains visible to the existing elevated game camera. Above/beyond the modest right wall show only the opaque warm cream upper-floor slab/roof cross-section (a plain softly shaded architectural surface), NOT a train platform, NOT outdoors, NOT another room, no windows or giant tall upright wall. Replace the towering vertical wall at right with this modest capped wall and gently receding opaque floor-slab cut surface. No towering upright posts beyond cap. Upper floor interior itself is NOT shown. Preserve all ground-floor navigation layout and object positions EXACTLY: four ticket windows lower left, entrance threshold lower center, mural and bench at left, ONE seated passenger with luggage, freestanding map board, detector and scanner, glass partitions and security desk, staircase rising one storey at rear and the lift next to it. Preserve all floor tiles and plant positions and empty circulation space. DO NOT show train, tracks, platform, platform canopy, or right-hand stairs. No text on signs. Warm painted gouache game style same as input, 1024x1536 portrait. The aim is a cozy substantial SINGLE-STOREY ticket hall underneath 2F, not a cavernous atrium. Maintain production-art coordinates.
